name: Beta firmware (md-26A09-132401)
about: Tag 'BETA'. This release unpacks 21 scatter pieces and ends at flash 0xfeb9c (5,220 bytes free). DSP2's boot upload occupies P:0x13b600..0x13c5ff; discovery excludes that entire range from model placement. DSP1's drive window starts at P:0xa3f.

qualification.by: Owner confirmed successful flashing and operation on hardware on 2026-10-13, after transfer through UM-ONE. Emulator audio, assignment, controls and kit checks also passed; see the recorded build hash and scope in docs/BASES.md.
qualification.unproven: Detailed hardware coverage of added-model UW sample playback, external-input effects, sustained overload/timing and visual category redraw was not recorded.

hostSend.why: Host-send reordering is not qualified on beta 26A09; the default ordered recovery is used instead.

unmuteFix.why: The beta enters its own add-on code from the sequencer's tick handler and buffer toggle, so the sequencer the fix is written against is not there.

midiChroma.why: The beta feeds MIDI through its own per-block queue in its add-on (entered from the DSP interrupt), neither X.14's real-time path nor OS 1.63's MIDI task: not implemented.

pitchLabels.why: The beta already replaces the knob-value draw this option hooks (0x22999e calls 0x2d4e9c): its own TONAL labels are retained. Chaining model pitch labels into that routine has not been qualified.
